name: esd-diode-clamp-cv
description: Issue #87: small-signal AC capacitance at the PAD node of the diode_nd2ps_06v0 ESD clamp from layout/gds/gf180_tmds_pad_v2.gds (DR-0011's ratified clamp device), as a function of device size, at 0 V and at the TMDS operating bias, across the full PVT matrix. Diode counterpart of sim/esd-clamp-cv (issue #12's GGNMOS study); feeds the redesigned verdict in design/esd-capacitance-budget.md. Not itself an ESD qualification (no tester, no parts).
claim: spec/decisions/0011-pad-esd-strategy.md -- the <=2 pF/pad budget (ESD clamp + pad parasitic combined, carried forward unrelaxed from DR-0005), specifically the diode clamp's own junction-capacitance contribution as a function of clamp size, at both 0 V and the DR-0002/DR-0006 2.8-3.3 V operating bias.

cap_w444_opv.description: sanity ceiling only (50 pF) -- catches a broken AC probe (open circuit / zero current), not a DR-0005/DR-0011 compliance gate. The 2 pF budget comparison is a design-doc computation across every corner's measured value, not a per-corner pass/fail on this record.
